forbidden: P0 GT node oracle as a proposal source

proposal_origin.eligible: pre-existing local raw-image or detector artifact whose candidate generation is demonstrably label-independent and predates this audit
proposal_origin.ineligible: GT coordinates, GT-matched rows selected by label, the P0 oracle, newly invented coordinates, pseudo-masks, or a proposal routine whose raw-image inputs are absent

candidate_identity_and_join.join: exact dataset identity plus immutable candidate identity; no nearest-GT or matched-GT field may participate
candidate_identity_and_join.deduplication: canonical identity equality only; ambiguous collisions fail closed
candidate_identity_and_join.required_coverage: all fixed fit-only groups needed by a 44b6-first grouped-fold run, with zero audit/test/CV57 identities

unlabeled_background.definition: every frozen proposal not selected as a positive fit label, counted from the deployment candidate universe before any GT join
unlabeled_background.required: finite exact count per dataset and family from the same immutable candidate bank
forbidden_substitutes: GT complement constructed from restored GT nodes

controls.noop: compile no actions against the frozen baseline
controls.isolated_node_add: same selected node identities with zero incident edges; expected scientific negative control only
controls.topology_complete_restore: same selected node identities with every declared incident addition, deletion, incoming/outgoing replacement, and expected conflict edge in one N1 restore_topology action

topology_completion_rule.atomicity: one action owns its added node, all added incident edges, all removed/replaced incident conflicts, and the exact expected conflict boundary
topology_completion_rule.minimum_topology: at least one time-forward incident edge per restored node
topology_completion_rule.validity: 100% of retained single actions and their combined deterministic batch must compile under frozen N1; otherwise PARK_CONTRACT

false_node_stress.construction: add the first k deterministically designated harmful/background node actions without changing positives or choosing k from outcomes
false_node_stress.report: for each k, exact node/action count, graph hash, adjusted/raw/node deltas, and validity
false_node_stress.selection: stress diagnostics never choose a threshold or gate

folds_and_seeds.fit_source_rule: training/calibration/router/threshold sources are fold-fit groups only
folds_and_seeds.held_gate_rule: 44b6 held-fit graph first; no family pooling

decision_lines.candidate_prerequisite_go: authentic label-independent origin, exact unlabeled background, complete fit-only 44b6 coverage, unambiguous join, and 100% N1-valid atomic actions
decision_lines.candidate_prerequisite_park: any missing origin proof, missing raw/detection artifact, GT-contaminated selection, incomplete family coverage, undefined background, ambiguous join, or N1-invalid action
decision_lines.graph_kill_44b6: adjusted_delta<0.005 or raw_delta<0 or node_recall_delta<0; keep 6bba closed
decision_lines.graph_go_6bba: identical adjusted/raw/node rule after 44b6 GO only
decision_lines.null: no candidate actions or result graph byte-identical to no-op => PARK_NULL
decision_lines.proposal_diagnostics: candidate recall, precision, AUC, support, stability, and node diagnostics are report-only and never gate

external_compute.request_condition: only after an authenticated candidate path and credible measured runtime projection
external_compute.under_5h: request must carry a hard five-hour kill
